dialogue.text: Daro: I used to lift all this. Now I count it. Turns out that matters too.

description: Daro hurt his shoulder unloading the Salt Thread. The clerk kept him on to count instead of lift. He compares island supplies against a manifest and asks the child to inspect the labels along the waterfront. When the oil count is short, he remembers Harker carrying something toward the ring and asks for a quiet conversation rather than a fight. Recovering the sealed tin lets him see counting as useful work and the island as a place whose windows need light.

links.description: Asks the protagonist to recover an island oil tin Harker borrowed for the ring, without a fight.
Quoted dialogue: After the oil has been returned.
